text: Coverage in Jordan was taken by a **black** Google car, without a red brake light.
NOTE: Jordan is the only Middle Eastern country where a black Google car without an antenna or a red brake light can be found.
text_zh: 約旦的街景是由一台沒有紅色煞車燈的**黑色** Google 車拍攝的。
註：約旦是中東唯一能找到沒有天線或紅色煞車燈的黑色 Google 車的國家。

text: Jordanian licence plates are **white** and can be long or short. Commercial transport vehicles, such as taxis, have a distinctive **green strip** on the left.
NOTE: In the Middle East, the green strip is only found in Jordan.
The UAE also uses long white plates. Israel however only uses yellow licence plates. In Palestine, both white domestic and yellow Israeli plates are common.
text_zh: 約旦車牌是**白色**的，可以長牌或短牌。計程車等商業運輸車輛在左側有一個明顯的**綠色邊條**。
註：在中東，綠色邊條僅見於約旦。
阿拉伯聯合大公國也使用長白牌。然而以色列只使用黃色車牌。在巴勒斯坦，白色國內車牌和黃色以色列車牌都很常見。

text: The official language used in Jordan is **Arabic** and can be identified by its lines and dots.
NOTE: Unlike the UAE, Jordan does not have English writing on most commercial signs. This can be helpful to distinguish the two countries.
text_zh: 約旦使用的官方語言是**阿拉伯語**，可以透過其線條和點來辨識。
註：與阿拉伯聯合大公國不同，約旦的大多數商業標誌上沒有英文書寫。這有助於區分這兩個國家。

text: Roads in Jordan typically feature **yellow outside** and **white middle **lines.
NOTE: Other Middle Eastern countries such as the UAE and Israel can also have these road lines. Make sure to check other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 約旦的道路通常有**黃色外側**和**白色中間**的線條。
註：阿拉伯聯合大公國和以色列等其他中東國家也可能有這些道路標線。在猜測之前，請務必檢查其他線索。

text: Jordanian chevrons are **white with red arrows**.
NOTE: You can use chevrons to distinguish between Jordan and Israel: the Israeli chevrons are black with white arrows.
text_zh: 約旦的轉彎標誌是**白底紅箭頭**。
註：你可以利用轉彎標誌來區分約旦和以色列：以色列的轉彎標誌是黑底白箭頭。

text: These are three common electricity poles that you will find in Jordan. Rounded concrete poles have either a **diagonal support** or consist of three horizontal **Y pole tops.** You may additionally see thin, two support metal poles with three vertical coils.
text_zh: 這些是你在約旦會找到的三種常見電線桿。圓形混凝土電線桿要麼有**斜向支撐**，要麼由三個水平的**Y形桿頂**組成。你可能還會看到帶有三個垂直線圈的細長雙支撐金屬桿。

text: Jordan is a **very arid** country, with limited vegetation and a lot of almost completely lifeless desert. The lushest parts will still only have the look of an [arid Mediterranean landscape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zvmGEnAftHUVwb6N9).
text_zh: 約旦是一個**非常乾旱**的國家，植被有限，且有許多幾乎毫無生氣的沙漠。最茂盛的部分也只會呈現[乾旱地中海景觀](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zvmGEnAftHUVwb6N9)的外觀。

text: Most buildings in Jordan are made of **bright sandstone bricks** and have flat roofs.
NOTE: Similar sandstone bricks are also common in [Jerusalem](https://maps.app.goo.gl/asRSSgsgJHajzb9N6) and in [the West Bank](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MSSFNKXV4ux3cFhq8).
text_zh: 約旦的大多數建築物都由**明亮的砂岩磚**建造，並配有平屋頂。
註：類似的砂岩磚在[耶路撒冷](https://maps.app.goo.gl/asRSSgsgJHajzb9N6)和[約旦河西岸](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MSSFNKXV4ux3cFhq8)也很常見。

text: On occasion, the road quality in Jordan is reflective of its age. Roads are well travelled and can be in poor condition. The heat has caused the asphalt to buckle, creating **warped cracks** in the road.
NOTE: In general, the road quality as a whole tends to be worse than Israel.
text_zh: 有時候，約旦的道路品質反映了它的歷史。道路經常有人走，狀況可能不太好。高溫導致柏油路面變形，在路上形成了**扭曲的裂縫**。
注意：整體而言，約旦的道路品質通常比以色列差。

text: Jordan only has Street View coverage in the **far** **western part** of the country. Coverage is limited to bigger towns and main roads in this area.

NOTE: Coverage ends just north of Jerash. Even though Irbid is the second largest city of Jordan, it has zero official coverage. In the south, coverage extends all the way to the coastal town of Aqaba, but not south of it.
text_zh: 約旦只有在該國的**最西部**才有街景覆蓋。這部分的覆蓋範圍僅限於較大的城鎮和主要道路。
注意：覆蓋範圍在傑拉什正北方就結束了。儘管伊爾比德是約旦第二大城市，但它完全沒有官方街景。在南部，覆蓋範圍一路延伸到沿海城鎮亞喀巴，但沒有延伸到亞喀巴以南。

text: **Amman** is by far the largest city in Jordan with extensive coverage. It is a bustling, developed metropolis with a distinct **“big city” feel** to it. It is slightly hilly and most of the city consists of medium-sized apartment blocks.
text_zh: **安曼**是約旦最大且街景最廣泛的城市。這是一座繁華、開發程度高且具有明顯**「大城市」感**的都會區。它有些起伏的山坡，市區大部分由中型公寓大樓組成。

text: **Highway 15** is the longest **divided highway** with coverage in Jordan. Most of the road is surrounded by desert landscape. It is also surrounded by rocky hills in the south closer to Aqaba.

NOTE: Highway 35 north of Madaba and highway 40 west of Amman are also divided but do not feature a desert landscape, while the divided highway 80 in the south runs mainly from east to west, making it distinguishable.
text_zh: **15號公路**是約旦覆蓋範圍內最長的**分隔雙向公路**。公路大部分被沙漠景觀環繞。在南部靠近亞喀巴的地方，周圍則是岩石山丘。
注意：馬達巴以北的35號公路和安曼以西的40號公路也是分隔道路，但沒有沙漠景觀，而南部的80號分隔公路主要呈東西走向，這點讓它很容易辨認。

text: **Highway 35** connecting Amman and Jerash is a divided road surrounded by hills speckled with green vegetation.
NOTE: Highway 40 west of Amman is also divided and features a similar landscape. However, the **T-shaped** lamppost shown in the image is only found on highway 35 which helps distinguish the two.
text_zh: 連接安曼和傑拉什的**35號公路**是一條周圍點綴著綠色植被山丘的分隔道路。
注意：安曼以西的40號公路也是分隔道路，且具有類似的景觀。不過，圖片中顯示的**T字形**路燈僅見於35號公路，這有助於區分這兩條路。

text: **Highway 40** is a recognisable divided** **road surrounded by low, green shrubbery that makes its way west of Amman through the hilly terrain into the sandy area close to the Dead Sea.
NOTE: **Y-shaped **lamp posts as shown in the image can be found along the length of highway 40, making it distinguishable from highway 35 north of Amman.
text_zh: **40號公路**是一條好認的分隔**道路**，周圍環繞著低矮的綠色灌木叢，從安曼以西穿過丘陵地形，一直延伸到死海附近的沙地區域。
注意：如圖片所示，沿著40號公路全長可以找到**Y字形**路燈，這使其有別於安曼以北的35號公路。

text: The **Dead Sea** can be found directly west along the northern portion of Highway 65.
NOTE: There is a long, flat,** expansive ridge** on the other side, which is useful to differentiate this from other bodies of water.
text_zh: **死海**位於65號公路北部正西方。
注意：對岸有一道長而平坦的**開闊山脊**，這有助於將其與其他水體區分開來。

text: **Highway 65** is a single lane, north to south highway. It features long, sandy stretches of road south of Feifa valley. Now and then, you may encounter overcast coverage on some sections.
NOTE: When on the portion of road near the airport by Aqaba, you can find sunset coverage.
text_zh: **65號公路**是一條南北向的單線公路。菲法谷以南的路段有著長長的沙地。偶爾你會在某些路段遇到陰天覆蓋的街景。
注意：當身處亞喀巴機場附近的路段時，你可以看到日落街景。

text: Near and in the city of Madaba, you will find **flat fields** which are sometimes tilled. They uniquely have the characteristic of **rich, red soil.**
NOTE: The fields continue both north and south of Madaba, along Highway 35.
text_zh: 在馬達巴市內及附近，你會看到**平坦的田野**，有時會被耕種。它們具有**肥沃的紅土**這項獨特特徵。
注意：這些田野在馬達巴的南北兩側沿著35號公路綿延。

text: This arid rolling hill valley is located near the almost dried out river of Wadi al Hasa on Highway 35. The rock is **rounded and smooth,** with a single lane highway running through the center.
text_zh: 這片乾旱的波狀丘陵山谷位於35號公路上的瓦迪哈薩（Wadi al Hasa）乾涸河流附近。岩石**圓潤且平滑，**中央有一條單線公路穿過。

text: For a large majority of Highway 80 and its turns, this **divided valley road** is surrounded by **large, rigid mountains.** When turning onto the stretch of road leading to Aqaba, the mountains level off.
NOTE: The road direction of Highway 80 is east to west, as opposed to Highway 15, which runs north to south.
text_zh: 80號公路的大多數路段和轉彎處，這條**分隔山谷道路**都被**巨大而僵硬的山脈**所環繞。當轉入通往亞喀巴的路段時，山勢就會變得平緩。
注意：80號公路的道路方向是東西走向，而南北走向的則是15號公路。

text: This long stretch of **jagged mountains** can be found on the eastern to southern side of Aqaba.
text_zh: 這段長長的**崎嶇山脈**可以在亞喀巴的東側至南側找到。

text: In **Amman**, taxis are yellow and green.
NOTE: The colours of taxis can be useful to distinguish between Jordanian cities.
text_zh: 在**安曼**，計程車是黃綠相間的。
注意：計程車的顏色對於區分約旦的城市很有幫助。

text: In **Aqaba**, taxis are olive green on the top and black at the bottom.
text_zh: 在**亞喀巴**（Aqaba），計程車頂部呈橄欖綠，底部呈黑色。

text: In **Madaba**, taxis are yellow with white bumpers.
text_zh: 在**馬達巴**（Madaba），計程車為黃色搭配白色保險桿。

text: In some parts of the town of **Wadi Musa**, unique mountains with distinctive, bulbous rock formations can be seen in the background.
text_zh: 在**瓦迪穆薩**（Wadi Musa）城鎮的部分地區，背景中可以看到具有獨特球狀岩石地貌的奇特山脈。

text: West of the town of **Wadi Musa**, a collection of trekkers can be found in and around **Petra**, a rock-cut city from antiquity. This trekker coverage features highly eroded reddish rocks, narrow gorges, and occasionally groups of tourists crowding around the archaeological sites.
NOTE: While not likely to appear in competitive or pinpointable maps, these trekkers are a mainstay in many maps, including the default World map.
text_zh: 在**瓦迪穆薩**鎮以西，可以在古代石刻城市**佩特拉**（Petra）內及周邊找到一系列徒步拍攝影像（trekker）。這項徒步拍攝街景的特徵是高度侵蝕的微紅色岩石、狹窄的峽谷，以及偶爾聚集在考古遺址周圍的遊客群。
注意：雖然這些 trekker 不太可能出現在競技或可精準定位的地圖中，但它們是許多地圖（包含預設的 World 地圖）中的主要元素。
